task_definition.task_description: Please find some trending alternatives in electronics for the Sony XM5 headphones, then generate an invoice for buying 2 of them and send it to user@example.com for payment. After that, confirm the order, check my checking account balance, get the USD to JPY exchange rate, and then send me an in-app medium-priority “Trip Summary” alert with my balance converted to JPY.

user_input.query: Please find some trending alternatives in electronics to the Sony XM5 headphones for product_id p_sony_xm5_blk, then create an invoice for quantity 2 and send it to user@example.com for payment using stripe. After that, confirm the order for user_id user_001, check my checking account balance from my account_type checking account, get the USD to JPY exchange rate for the target_currency JPY, and send me an in-app alert on the app channel with medium priority titled “Trip Summary” that includes my balance converted to JPY.
user_input.title: Trip Summary
